metric_definitions.offbeat_attacks: Note onsets at noninteger quarter-beat positions, counted across parts.
metric_definitions.full_texture: Written time when every notated part contains a sounding note, including holds; tails excluded.
metric_definitions.mean_sounding_parts: Time-weighted sounding part count over the entire written duration, including rests.
metric_definitions.upper_leaps_over_octave: Consecutive upper-part pitches more than 12 semitones apart, including joins separated by rests.
metric_definitions.new_prepared_suspensions: Explicit added suspension records in the revision annotations; not a count of every dissonance in the music.

scope: Original symbolic compositions and synthesized studies. A critical score and engineering review, not a human auditory assessment, Bach-equivalence claim, or proof of every historical contrapuntal convention.
